name: Kingsway Tunnel
facts: Kingsway Tunnel, opened by Queen Elizabeth II on 24 June 1971, was built to relieve Queensway Tunnel’s 11‑million‑vehicle congestion, with construction spanning five years and a twin‑tunnel design completed by 1974.
The 1.5‑mile Kingsway Tunnel carries two 12‑ft lanes per tunnel, handling an average of 45,000 vehicles daily, and uniquely permits heavy goods vehicles unlike any other Mersey crossing.
In 2016, Kingsway received a 75‑mile LED lighting overhaul, installing energy‑efficient lights and earning a “good” safety rating from EU inspectors after the 1999 Mont Blanc Tunnel fire.
